description: A rule that spreads the valkey pods evenly across topology domains.

maxSkew.description: Maximum difference in the number of matching pods between two domains.

topologyKey.description: Node label key that defines a domain.

whenUnsatisfiable.description: What to do when the constraint can not be satisfied: keep the pod `Pending`, or schedule it anyway.

nodeAffinityPolicy.description: Whether the node affinity of the pod is honored when counting the domains.

nodeTaintsPolicy.description: Whether the taints of the nodes are honored when counting the domains.

matchLabelKeys.description: Pod label keys whose values are combined with `labelSelector`.
